messages:
Mira: Quick sync — planning the Ignite Labs launch experiment. Idea: 30m hands-on workshop + prompt-template pack + starter compute credits awarded when attendees complete the lab. Need routing rules, benchmark narrative, webinar comms, and onboarding nudges.
Jon: Sounds good. Proposed dates? also want a partner co-host?
Mira: Thinking May 12 or May 13. Mosaic Labs can co-host (they'll handle a short demo). We'll gate credits behind a short lab completion form so we can measure activation.
Priya: Routing note — form should tag submissions with 'ignite-workshop' + utm params. If company_size > 50 route to sales queue, otherwise to growth. Also attach partner_id when link has it. Sample pseudo-config: 
``` 
if form.tag == "ignite-workshop" and company.size > 50:
  route = "sales"
else:
  route = "growth"
# add slack notify to #sales-inbound and #growth-nurture
```
Leo: Growth team capacity? We usually get a small surge after workshops. Recommend an SDR buddy for the week of the event and a Slack alert for every enterprise lead.
Kelly: For the benchmark narrative — focus on two quick outcomes: 1) immediate prompt activation (tokens/session) and 2) day-7 retention of prompt usage. Secondary: conversion to paid within 14 days. That gives us measurable signal for the PLG experiment.
Mira: Love that. Also want to A/B test subject lines and post copy. Suggestions: 
- A: "Build with Redwood: hands-on LLM workshop"
- B: "Ship LLM features faster — join our lab"
Kelly: I'll draft the two subject lines + two LinkedIn post variants. Recommend 2x LinkedIn + 1x Twitter + partner co-mail. Skip Product Hunt for this one.
Jon: Partner ask: can we give Mosaic a shareable invite link that includes partner_id and maps to utm_source=mosaic? example: https://redwood.ai/ignite?partner_id=mosaic&utm_source=mosaic&utm_campaign=ignite-labs
Priya: I'll wire the partner_id param into the form and the routing rule. Also adding a quick webhook to push enterprise leads to Salesforce with tag 'ignite-workshop'.
growth-bot: Draft playbook created: /playbooks/ignite-routing (status: draft)
Mira: Tasks roundup — Jon: confirm partner assets & speaker. Priya: implement routing + webhook + form params. Kelly: benchmark deck + post copy. Leo: SDR buddy for event week + Slack alert. I'll own webinar comms and invite flow.
Jon: Confirm partner and share speaker bio by EOD Friday.
Priya: Routing and webhook PR target by Tue morning.
Kelly: Copy draft by Mon noon, will include A/B subject lines.
Mira: Quick poll for time — Wed 10am PT (:one:) or Thu 1pm PT (:two:). Please react.
Kelly: :one:
Leo: :one:
Jon: :two: (but flexible)
Mira: Okay we'll aim for Wed 10am PT — thanks team. Will follow up with calendar + playbook links.
